Tom...

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: Can't deploy my Shiny app from Rstudio: Missing dependency 'Rcpp' for package 'httpuv'
parts:
Hi all,

I think we've gotten to the bottom of this issue. To fix it, please update the following packages to their latest versions:

devtools::install_github('rstudio/packrat')
devtools::install_github('rstudio/rsconnect')
devtools::install_github('rstudio/shinyapps')


We've been working on the internals of the these packages, which has exposed some issues. I apologize for the inconvenience and I appreciate everyones patience. 

-Andy
